channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the Senate
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/18/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: SB 417 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to the appointment of attorneys ad litem and the compensation of certain attorneys ad litem in suits affecting the parent-child relationship filed by a governmental entity.

item.title: SB 418 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the approval by the commissioner of education of and terms of certain contracts or contract amendments entered into by a school district during the pendency of certain special investigations authorized by the commissioner.

item.title: SB 419 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to agreements regarding courses offered jointly by public junior colleges and school districts, organizations, or other persons operating high schools.

item.title: SB 420 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the stray dog and cat sterilization grant program and county and municipal sterilization operations.

item.title: SB 421 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the conveyance of certain park land owned by certain municipalities.

item.title: SB 422 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the authority of certain municipalities to use certain tax revenue for hotel and convention center projects.

item.title: SB 423 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to deceptive trade practices involving a solicitation in connection with a good or service involving the approval of authorizations issued by a governmental entity.

item.title: SB 424 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to electronic communications sent to a state or local agency or other entity with respect to an expunction or proposed expunction of a person's arrest records and files.

item.title: SB 425 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the authority of certain municipalities to annex enclaves and near enclaves.

item.title: SB 426 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the testing of evidence containing biological materials in capital cases.

item.title: SB 427 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the authority of the Texas Forensic Science Commission to review and refer certain cases to the office of capital and forensic writs.

item.title: SB 428 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the consequences of a criminal conviction or placement on deferred adjudication on a person's eligibility for an occupational license and related reporting requirements for licensing authorities.

item.title: SB 429 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the addition of bromazolam and clobromazolam to Penalty Group 1 of the Texas Controlled Substances Act.

item.title: SB 430 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the electronic payment of ad valorem taxes; authorizing a fee.

item.title: SB 431 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the confidentiality of certain information for a current or former administrative law judge for the State Office of Administrative Hearings.

item.title: SB 432 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to the eligibility of certain political subdivisions to receive a state loan or grant following the political subdivision's failure to comply with certain financial reporting requirements.

item.title: SB 433 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to a grant program for counties to provide prisoners serving a sentence in a county jail with certain identification documents on discharge.

item.title: SB 434 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hinojosa, Juan "Chuy"
item.description: Relating to requiring a landlord to provide a method for residential tenants to make rent payments without a fee for processing the payment.
